Call-finalize word emission (emit/calls.rs: emit_call / finalize_call) — no
fixture-level (input.bas + expected.pcode) coverage is possible yet, for any
of the three finalize paths (dispatch finalize word, result-descriptor,
finalize type-node), including the dispatch finalize word path fixed in this
change.

Reason: the fixture harness drives the real front-end pipeline (Parser ->
bind -> lower_module) and diffs the emitted bytes against an oracle capture.
lower_module never constructs a `0x61` call node — user/intra-module calls
are lowered directly by `lower_call` (crates/vb6-codegen/src/lower/expr.rs),
which emits call bytes itself and never builds a `CallDescriptor` or reaches
`Emitter::emit_call`/`finalize_call`. There is currently no VB6 source form
that reaches this code path through the real pipeline, so there is nothing
for the user to compile against an oracle here.

Coverage for `emit_call`/`finalize_call` is therefore unit-level only,
constructing `CallDescriptor` directly and asserting on the emitted byte
stream (see crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/emit_tests.rs, the
`emit_call_*`/`emit_call_dispatch_*` tests) — this was already the existing
pattern before this change (the byref-common-path and finalize-type-node-gate
tests), not something newly introduced to work around the gap.

Once front-end lowering is wired to build `0x61` call nodes (out of scope for
this change), fixture captures for the dispatch finalize word, the
result-descriptor path (also currently unreachable in code — see the comment
on the `_` arm in `emit_call`), and the finalize type-node path (region
0x140000, still gated pending the type-pool allocator) can be added and
oracle-verified then.

---

Compound-op store (emit/assign.rs: Emitter::emit_compound_op_store) and the
object/UDT-destination store sub-dispatch (Emitter::emit_object_store_subdispatch)
— no fixture-level (input.bas + expected.pcode) coverage yet.

`e2e_compound_op_store_long_increment/input.bas` (`x = x + 1`): this is the
form the task that ported this path named as the expected trigger for
`EbEmitAssignmentStmt`'s flag-0x400 + 0x69-LHS shortcut, but the current
front-end lowering (crates/vb6-codegen/src/lower/assign.rs) does not build a
`0x2c`/`0x69` node shape for any source form yet — `lower_assign` emits the
load/store bytes directly without ever routing through `emit_expr`'s
statement-level assignment dispatch. There is currently no way to reach
`emit_compound_op_store` through the real pipeline, so no expected.pcode can
be captured until that lowering exists. Coverage is unit-level only (see
`crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/emit_tests.rs`, the `compound_op_store_*` and
`assignment_statement_compound_op_store_*` tests), constructing the node
shape directly and asserting the emitted bytes — verified against the
decompiled routine at the assembly level (register-precise, not just the
higher-level decompile), not fabricated.

`e2e_udt_variable_assign/input.bas` (`a = b` for a UDT-typed `Point`): a
candidate to reach `emit_object_store_subdispatch` (dest region `0xf0000`,
UDT/object destination), but UDT assignment in this codegen currently lowers
through the case-0xe "UDT copy" op-class-1 branch (`emit_opcode2(0x2fe, ...)`
in emit/expr.rs), not through `emit_assign_op`'s object-destination branch —
and `emit_expr`'s own case-0xe entry additionally guards `node_hi == 0xf0000`
unconditionally before dispatching on op-class, which currently blocks
`emit_assign_op`'s object-destination branch from being reached through the
ordinary dispatch tree at all (a pre-existing gap, not introduced by this
change). Coverage is likewise unit-level only (the `object_store_subdispatch_*`
tests), calling the pure selection function directly with representative
destination/source type tags.

If a source form is found that does reach either path through the real
pipeline, capture `expected.pcode` for it and this note can be dropped.

---

`Emitter::emit_reference` descriptor kinds 3, 5, and 0xa (the `word6`-bit-0-set
sub-case), plus `Emitter::expr2_finalize_tail`'s recursive re-entry — no
fixture-level (input.bas + expected.pcode) coverage is possible yet.

Reason: none of these shapes are constructed by any currently-wired descriptor
builder reachable from real source.

- Kind 3 and kind 5 are never produced by `init_expr_descriptor`,
  `call_conv_descriptor`, or `emit_setup_binary_operation` — the only
  descriptor constructors currently wired to the front end. Kind 3 becomes
  reachable only via `expr2_finalize_tail`'s own recursive re-entry (a fresh,
  all-zero, kind-3 descriptor); kind 5 has no producer anywhere in the
  codebase yet.
- Kind 0xa's `word6`-bit-0-set sub-case is constructed by
  `emit_setup_binary_operation`, but only inside a branch gated on the node's
  own `word[1] & 0x8000` bit being set — and the caller (`emit_expr`'s `0x69`
  case in `crates/vb6-codegen/src/emit/expr.rs`) already loud-gates that exact
  bit before calling `emit_setup_binary_operation` at all (see the
  "EbSetupBinaryOperation ByRef stack-init" gate). So with today's wiring the
  bit is always clear by the time `emit_setup_binary_operation` runs, and its
  kind-0xa branch's `word6 |= 1` line can never execute. This sub-case will
  become reachable once that outer gate is closed.
- `expr2_finalize_tail`'s recursion is exercised today only by kind 9 (and
  8/0xb) — descriptor kinds themselves reachable via `emit_setup_binary_operation`
  — but whether any *real source form* currently reaches `emit_setup_binary_operation`
  with an nOp outside {5, 6-without-the-flag} (i.e. actually triggers the
  recursion, not just the early return) was not established this pass.

Coverage for all of the above is therefore unit-level only (see
`crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/emit_tests.rs`, the `emit_reference_kind3_*`,
`emit_reference_kind5_*`, `emit_reference_kind_0xa_*`, and
`expr2_finalize_tail_*` tests), constructing the descriptor directly and
asserting on the emitted byte stream — verified against the assembly-level
trace of the routine (register-precise), not fabricated.

If a source form is found that does reach any of these shapes through the
real pipeline, capture `expected.pcode` for it and drop the relevant part of
this note.

---

`emit_expr`'s `0x42`/`0x43` dispatch-binding sub-path (`crates/vb6-codegen/src/emit/expr.rs`)
— no fixture-level (input.bas [+ input.cls] + expected.pcode) coverage yet.

Reason: `lower_module`/`lower_expr` never construct a `0x42` or `0x43` bound
node for any source form today — those op codes are reached only by hand-built
node shapes in `crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/emit_tests.rs`
(`case_0x42_dispatch_binding_emits_0x2ff`, `case_0x43_dispatch_binding_emits_0x3f6`,
and the two fallback-path tests). Reaching this from real source needs an
early-bound call/member reference on an object whose resolved binding classifies
as an early-bound dispatch (module-symbol-heap member kind 4) — i.e. class
member access, which the front end does not lower yet (see the object/class
tier noted throughout `re_lab/pcode_lab/remaining_work_ledger.md`).

If a source form is found that does reach this path through the real pipeline,
capture `expected.pcode` for it and drop this note.

---

`Emitter::convert_expression_type`, `resolver::fill_binding_desc`, and
`Emitter::emit_binary_op_code_temp_descriptor` (the binding-emit-tail cluster,
2026-07-14 port) — no fixture-level (input.bas [+ input.cls] + expected.pcode)
coverage yet.

Reason: all three are reached, in the real compiler, only from the resolver's
category 0xd/0xe/0xf dispatch (and the method/object-binding gate's
has-a-slot sub-case) inside `resolve_ident_ref` — a dispatch this pipeline's
`resolve_ident_ref` does not yet implement (it still loud-gates those
categories; see the ledger). Reaching any of these three functions through
real source additionally needs class/object member access, which the front
end does not lower yet. Coverage is unit-level only (see
`crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/emit_tests.rs`'s `convert_expression_type_*`
and `emit_binary_op_code_temp_descriptor_*` tests, and
`crates/vb6-codegen/src/tests/resolver_tests.rs`'s `fill_binding_desc_*`
tests), constructing the node/record shapes directly and asserting on the
emitted bytes / returned descriptor — verified against the decompiled
routines at the C level (not fabricated).

`EbEmitBinaryOpCode`'s second half (building its final kind-8 output
descriptor) is not ported at all — it depends on a side-table located via a
module-heap pointer this pipeline has no model for; see the private citation
note for the exact discriminant.

If a source form is found that does reach any of these through the real
pipeline, capture `expected.pcode` for it and drop the relevant part of this
note.
